lot: ZECATHON demo lot (non-deliverable: escrow is refunded after settlement)
settlement_rule: uniform-price: every winner pays the lowest winning bid
bid_format: memo = 'BID <amount>' attached to a shielded (z->z) payment; amount sent = escrow

hidden: who lost and by how much

honest_limits: the seller learns every amount once revealed - a malicious seller could front-run or leak
a third party cannot verify that a published clearing price matches the sealed bids
no live 'current highest bid' is possible: amounts are encrypted to the seller only
